cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've outgrown the tool drawer I taught you to organize. Sorting this shed could give you a whole workshop of your own.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Until you dump paint tins over everything again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the final lesson: make the teacher obey the labels. You could set every shelf's rules.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including one you're forbidden to touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Especially that one. Put it at eye level so I have to admire how thoroughly you've learned to keep me out.

reason: Preserve the useful Drive exchange while replacing generic training prefaces with specific corrections, qualified praise and claimed influence that make the mentor role determine A's tactic.
